title: Beta blockers / β受体阻滞剂（例：metoprolol；propranolol）

properties.Mechanism (MOA): Block β1 in heart → ↓HR and ↓contractility → ↓CO; also ↓renin release (β1) → ↓RAAS tone → ↓BP. / 阻断心脏β1 → 心率↓、收缩力↓ → CO↓；并抑制肾素释放（β1）→ RAAS张力↓ → 血压↓。
properties.Contraindications: Severe bradycardia/AV block; asthma/COPD caution (nonselective). / 严重心动过缓/房室传导阻滞；哮喘/COPD慎用（非选择性更需谨慎）。
properties.Indications: Hypertension with comorbid CAD/MI, some arrhythmias; specific HF regimens. / 合并冠心病/心肌梗死或某些心律失常的高血压；部分心衰方案。
properties.Adverse effects: Bradycardia, fatigue; bronchospasm with nonselective agents; masking hypoglycemia symptoms. / 心动过缓、乏力；非选择性者可致支气管痉挛；掩盖低血糖症状。
properties.Drug: Beta blockers / β受体阻滞剂（例：metoprolol；propranolol）
